_note: Ratchet state for .claude/battery.py assertion 4 — the corpus did not silently shrink. MACHINE-WRITTEN: battery.py is the only writer, and it only ever moves a count UP, except through an explicit --lower-ratchet with a --lower-reason, which is appended to 'lowers' below so every deliberate step over the gap stays on the record. Seeded empty by hand exactly once, because the declaration in NON_INSTRUMENTS has to exist before the file can and the battery refuses to run at all while its own selftest fails — so the file could not have been created by the tool that writes it. Counts start absent on purpose: the first run INITIALISES and says so, condition (8), and the SECOND run is the check. 'record_keys' (added 2026-09-06 by the same hand, same reason: the field has to be explained in the file a reader diffs) is the record SET beside its size — sorted (author|year|file:line) identities, one per line, so `git diff` on this file IS the composition audit. A count cannot see four records swapping identity under a flat total; the set can, and the battery prints added/removed/moved on every run. Sorted ordering is load-bearing. The count and the set are saved together and battery.py REFUSES this file if they ever disagree, so do not edit either by hand.

six wrong non-corpus pointers rewritten as SPELLED addresses (file name, the word line, the number) rather than deleted, so they leave the matchable population without losing their referents. Each was an INSTANCE of the defect its own paragraph documents: two fabricated spans that never held those lines at any commit, in two homes each (an instrument header and CLAUDE.md). Deletion was refused because for these six the address is simultaneously the defect AND the evidence the defect existed: remove it and the claim that the line never held that span loses its referent and stops being checkable. Re-runnable: pointer_check on this commit reports six fewer pointers and the SAME identity_oracle value, because none of the six carried an author+year oracle - they sat inside the counted population and RESOLVED, which is exactly why range-checking-only reported them green from the day they were written. The colon-delimited non-corpus pointers that remain are one content-anchored repair into commit_checked.sh plus two declared-correct fraction_check references
